steps.text: Slice the beetroot paper thin, dress with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt and leave for 10 minutes.
Top the blinis with crème fraîche, a folded slice of beetroot and a sprig of dill.
Slice and toast the baguette, then rub with garlic.
Dice the tomatoes, mix with torn basil and pile on the toasts.

veg.make_ahead: Soak up to 4 hours ahead, fry on the day

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets.
Soak the florets in the buttermilk and hot sauce in the fridge for 2 hours.
Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder, white pepper and salt. Dredge the cauliflower twice.
Fry at 175C in batches until deep golden and tender, then drain on paper towel.
Serve well before midnight.
Slice the vegetarian sausages thick on the diagonal and slice the onions.
Griddle the sausage pieces until charred.
Cook the onions slowly in the butter until soft.
Toss together with the mustard and spear on toothpicks.
Chop the chocolate.
Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate until frothy.
Pour into four mugs and pile the marshmallows on top.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk. Grate the onion.
Mix lightly with the plant-based mince, egg and salt, then roll into 20 balls.
Bake at 200C on a lined tray until browned and hot through.
Mix the tomato sauce with the brown sugar, brush over and bake a few minutes more.

veg.n: Fishnet zucchini wrapped breadsticks and ricotta

steps.text: Shave the zucchini into long thin ribbons with a peeler, brush with the oil and dust with the paprika.
Chargrill the ribbons for about 1 minute a side until soft and bendy, then cool.
Cut the ribbons into thin strips and wind criss-cross around the breadsticks like fishnet.
Stand them up in a tall glass.
Whip the ricotta with salt and pepper and serve in a small bowl alongside.
Boil the eggs hard, cool, peel and halve.
Whip the yolks with mayonnaise and pipe back into the whites.
Slice the smoked tofu very thin and lay on buttered rye squares with a sprig of dill.
Glaze the vegetarian cocktail sausages in a pan with the sugar and a splash of water until sticky and hot through.
Serve on silver trays.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, add toppings just before serving

ingredients.item: blue food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Whisk the apple juice, sugar and agar in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Tint blue with the food colouring.
Pour half into four glasses and leave for about 15 minutes until just set. Keep the rest warm.
Push the gummy fish into the jelly, pour over the rest and chill until firm.
Whip the cream and crush the shortbread.
Top with cream, shortbread for sand and a shell shaved from the white chocolate.
Whisk the agar into the cold cream with most of the sugar.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, stirring, then take off the heat, stir in the rosewater and pour into four glasses.
Set in the fridge.
Crush the raspberries with the remaining sugar and spoon on top with a rose petal.
Mix the apple juice with the lemon juice and pour into a tray to freeze.
Freeze, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes.
Whip the cream and fold in the marshmallow creme.
Spoon the slush into glasses and top with the cream. Brew a pot of English breakfast tea for the grown-ups.

veg.n: Mr Potato Head loaded potato bites (vegetarian)

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender and drain.
Smash flat on a tray brushed with most of the olive oil and roast at 220C until crisp.
Grate the cheddar. Dice the smoked tofu small and fry in the rest of the oil with the paprika until crisp.
Top with cheese and the crisp tofu and return to the oven.
Add sour cream and chopped chives.

ingredients.item: soy sauce, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Rinse and cook the rice, then season with the vinegar and sugar and cool.
Cut the tofu into long strips, fry in the oil until golden, then splash with a little soy and cool.
Slice the avocado and cucumber into strips.
Spread rice over the nori, lay the fillings along each and roll tight.
Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy and pickled ginger.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled, reheat gently

steps.text: Sweat the leeks in the butter over low heat until soft.
Add the potatoes and vegetable stock and simmer until the potato is very tender.
Blend silky smooth with the cream and season.
Serve topped with chives and white pepper. Anyone can cook.

veg.n: Paris market baguette with brie and thyme mushrooms

steps.text: Take the salted butter out of the fridge so it is soft at room temperature.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil over high heat with the thyme leaves until golden, then season and cool a little.
Warm the baguettes in a 200C oven for 6 minutes until the crust crackles when you squeeze it.
Split each baguette lengthways and spread thickly with the butter.
Fill with the mushrooms and slices of brie, close and cut into short lengths to share.
Halve the mushrooms and slice the garlic.
Melt the butter until foaming, add the garlic and chilli and cook briefly.
Add the mushrooms and toss over high heat until golden and glossy.
Add the vegetable stock and lemon juice and bubble briefly. Finish with chopped parsley and serve with crusty bread.

veg.n: Friendship, Maine hearts of palm rolls
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 3 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Drain the hearts of palm, pat dry and chop into chunks. Fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, finely diced celery and chives.
Butter the split buns and toast in a pan.
Pile the filling in.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil, season with salt and pepper and sear in a hot pan until tender and browned.
Slice thick.
Toast the sourdough. Mix the mayonnaise with chopped mint.
Build with crisp cos, ripe tomato and the mushrooms.

veg.n: "Sanka, ya dead?" lentil and mushroom patties
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, or freeze

steps.text: Chop the onion, chilli and mushrooms finely. Drain and rinse the lentils.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil until dry and browned, then add the lentils, thyme leaves, chilli, allspice and curry powder. Mash lightly and cool.
Cut the pastry into rounds and brush with turmeric water. Fill, fold and crimp.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toast the marshmallows over a flame until blistered and molten.
Squash each between two biscuits with a square of chocolate so it melts. Eat them by the handful.
Drain the artichokes and chop finely with the capers.
Fold into the cream cheese and sour cream with lemon juice, soy sauce and chopped chives.
Serve with potato chips.

veg.n: Rumaki smoky eggplant wrapped water chestnuts

steps.text: Slice the eggplant lengthways into 16 thin strips, brush with the oil and paprika and cook in a hot pan for 1 minute a side until bendy.
Drain the water chestnuts and wrap each in a strip of eggplant, held with a toothpick.
Brush with the soy, sugar and ginger.
Bake at 200C until sticky.
Slice the thick mushroom stems into rings and the caps into strips, then soak in the buttermilk.
Soak.
Dredge in cornmeal mixed with flour.
Fry at 185C in batches until golden.
Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.
Crumble the smoked tofu finely.
Mix into the cream cheese and sour cream with lemon juice, chopped dill and horseradish.
Spoon into a small bucket and serve with crackers.
Mix the chilli flakes with the salt on a plate.
Rub the rims of four pint glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Fill with ice.
Add lime juice, hot sauce, a few drops of soy sauce and tomato juice to each glass.
Top each with cold lager, stir once and crush the can.
Mix the chilli flakes with the salt on a plate.
Rub the rims of four pint glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Fill with ice.
Add lime juice, hot sauce, a few drops of soy sauce and tomato juice to each glass.
Top each with cold alcohol-free lager, stir once and crush the can.

veg.make_ahead: Roll up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Melt the butter and cook the mushrooms until all the liquid has gone.
Stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until very thick.
Spread in a dish, cover and chill overnight.
Shape into logs, roll in beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C in batches.
Serve with lime.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and slice.
Slice the smoked tofu thin and fry in the oil until crisp on both sides.
Toast the bread.
Layer the egg, crisp tofu, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise across three slices each.
Pin with toothpicks and cut into quarters.
Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets.
Whisk the flour, water, garlic powder and salt into a batter and toss the florets through.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Warm the barbecue sauce with the honey, toss the cauliflower through and bake 10 minutes more until sticky.
Beat the cream cheese with grated cheddar, soy sauce and chopped spring onions.
Roll into golf ball sizes and chill.
Toast and crush the pecans, roll the balls in them and spear each with a toothpick.
Bake the potatoes at 200C.
While they bake, fry the mushrooms in a little of the butter with the paprika and soy sauce until dark and crisp.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out and brush with the rest of the butter, melted.
Crisp the skins at 220C.
Fill with grated cheddar and the crisp mushrooms and bake again.
Top with sour cream and chives.
Cut the haloumi into large cubes and thread onto skewers with the tomatoes.
Melt the butter with crushed garlic, paprika and cayenne and brush over.
Grill, turning once, until the haloumi is golden, and squeeze lemon over.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic, chopped parsley, finely chopped shallot and a splash of brandy.
Sit the mushrooms cup side up in a baking dish and fill each one with the butter.
Bake at 200C until sizzling and the mushrooms are tender. Serve with baguette.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic, chopped parsley, finely chopped shallot and a splash of verjuice.
Sit the mushrooms cup side up in a baking dish and fill each one with the butter.
Bake at 200C until sizzling and the mushrooms are tender. Serve with baguette.
Blanch the broccolini and drain. Slice the garlic.
Char in a smoking pan with the garlic.
Toss with the mushroom stir-fry sauce and sesame oil. Stand them up in a dish like trees.

veg.make_ahead: Fill and steam on the day

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and warm water into a dough and knead.
Prove the dough.
Dice the mushrooms and fry hard in the oil until browned, then add the soy, hoisin and sugar and cook until sticky. Cool.
Divide the dough into 12 rounds, fill and pleat shut.
Prove again.
Steam.

veg.n: Hattori Hanzo's avocado and tamago nigiri

steps.text: Cook the sushi rice, season with the vinegar, caster sugar and salt and cool.
Shape the rice into small fingers.
Whisk the eggs with the omelette sugar and soy. Cook in thin layers in the oiled pan, rolling each layer up, then cool and slice.
Slice the avocado. Top the rice with a dab of wasabi and a slice of omelette or avocado.
Serve on a board with pickled ginger.

veg.n: Jalapeño cheese dip with chips and mushroom jerky

steps.text: Grate the cheddar and chop the jalapeños.
Warm the evaporated milk until steaming, then stir in the cheddar until smooth.
Add the jalapeño juice and jalapeños.
Pour into plastic bowls with corn chips and mushroom jerky on the side.
Press the tofu between paper towels under a heavy board, then tear into bite-sized pieces.
Mix with the soy, sake, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.
Press the tofu between paper towels under a heavy board, then tear into bite-sized pieces.
Mix with the soy, rice vinegar, water, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.
Slice the mushrooms and onion thin.
Sear the onion on a hot plate in oil until soft, then push aside and sear the mushrooms hard until browned. Season.
Lay the cheese over the mushrooms to melt.
Split the rolls and pile the filling in.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, cover and keep chilled

steps.text: Drain the artichokes, olives, capsicum, eggplant and mushrooms.
Arrange the vegetables and sliced cheese on a board with the olives.
Serve with the loaf torn into pieces.

veg.n: Moscow blini with black lentil caviar
veg.make_ahead: Batter can rest up to 2 hours

steps.text: Mix both flours, yeast and warm milk into a batter and rest until bubbly.
Meanwhile simmer the lentils in water until just tender, drain and dress with the soy and lemon juice. Cool.
Cook small spoonfuls of batter in butter in a pan until golden on both sides.
Top each with sour cream, a spoonful of lentils and dill.
Mix the mushrooms with the oil, lime juice, garlic and cumin.
Marinate for 30 minutes.
Grill the mushrooms hot, 4 minutes a side, then chop.
Bake the fries on a tray at 220C until crisp.
Cover with Monterey Jack and grill to melt.
Top with the mushrooms, avocado and sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the cucumber into rounds. Drain and finely chop the hearts of palm, bind in lemon mayonnaise and spoon on top.
Toast baguette slices and top with ricotta whipped with honey.
Shave the zucchini into long ribbons, brush with the oil and chargrill for 1 minute a side until bendy.
Halve the figs and wrap each half in a zucchini ribbon.
Serve on silver trays.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a thick batter.
Pat the vegetarian frankfurts dry and push onto sticks.
Heat the oil to 180C. Dip each one in batter and fry until deep golden.
Serve with mustard.

veg.n: Jean Girard's mushroom and cheese crêpes

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk to a smooth batter and rest.
Fry the mushrooms in a little of the butter until golden and season.
Cook thin crepes in the rest of the butter.
Fold half around the mushrooms and grated cheese and warm until melted.
Sprinkle the rest with sugar and lemon juice.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the cucumber, celery, carrots and radishes into long lean sticks.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with lemon juice, soy sauce and black pepper.
Stand the sticks in a glass on ice and serve with the dip.

veg.n: Day spa cucumber and beetroot bites
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep very cold

steps.text: Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds.
Whip the goat's cheese with lemon zest and pipe on top.
Slice the beetroot paper thin, toss with a squeeze of lemon juice and fold a piece on each with a dill frond.
Chill until serving.
Drain the chickpeas, mash roughly with a fork and mix with the mayonnaise, chopped capers, finely diced celery, spring onion and lemon juice.
Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds.
Spoon on the chickpea mix and finish with dill and black pepper. Keep it away from the cat.

veg.make_ahead: Shape up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Drain the hearts of palm, shred with a fork and squeeze dry in a clean tea towel.
Fold with the mayonnaise, egg, Dijon, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs.
Shape into 8 cakes.
Chill.
Pan-fry in the butter until golden.
Serve with lemon.
Cut the haloumi into small cubes and fry in the oil until golden all over.
Fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, diced celery and chives.
Butter the cut sides of the buns and toast.
Pile the haloumi in.
Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets.
Whisk the flour, water and salt into a batter and toss the florets through.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey, toss the cauliflower through and bake 5 minutes more.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream to dip.
Serve with celery sticks.

veg.n: Pledge week smoky eggplant jalapeño poppers

steps.text: Halve and seed the jalapenos.
Mix the cream cheese with the grated cheddar and fill each half.
Slice the eggplant lengthways into 24 thin strips. Brush with the oil, paprika and soy and cook in a hot pan for 1 minute a side until bendy.
Wrap each jalapeno half in a strip of eggplant and hold with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C until the eggplant is crisp at the edges.

veg.n: Wolfpack buffet hearts of palm cocktail

steps.text: Drain and rinse the hearts of palm, cut into thick pieces and toss with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Mix the tomato sauce with horseradish and lemon juice.
Chill the hearts of palm.
Pile them on a bag of crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.
Take the cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead so it comes up to room temperature.
Cut the cheddar into thick slices and the pasty into wedges.
Arrange on a board with pickled onions, chutney, sliced apple and bread, with a dish of butter.

veg.n: Village of the Year fete scotch eggs (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, serve cold or reheat at 180C

steps.text: Boil four of the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Wrap each egg in seasoned plant-based sausage mince, pressing it smooth and even.
Roll in flour, the remaining beaten egg, then panko.
Fry at 170C until deep golden and hot through, then halve.
Serve with English mustard.

veg.n: Four Leaf's jungle banh mi bites (vegetarian)

steps.text: Cut the carrot and daikon into matchsticks and quick-pickle in the vinegar and sugar.
Slice the tofu, fry in the oil until golden, then glaze with the hoisin and soy.
Split the baguettes and spread with the mushroom pâté.
Fill with the tofu, drained pickles, cucumber, coriander and chilli.
Cut into bites.

veg.make_ahead: Make ahead up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Mix the plant-based mince with the egg, grated cheese, chopped parsley, garlic and some salt. Roll into balls.
Brown the balls in batches in the oil.
Simmer in the crushed tomatoes until hot through.
Serve on toothpicks.

veg.n: Ned's labeled cheese and egg sandwiches

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise.
Make cheese and pickle sandwiches, and egg and lettuce sandwiches.
Cut small, wrap each in baking paper and write a name on it in marker.
Chill until needed.

veg.make_ahead: Roast the beetroot a day ahead

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil. Cut the sweet potato into small cubes and toss with the oil, cumin and a pinch of salt.
Roast both at 200C until tender, then peel the beetroot.
Blitz the beetroot with the drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and garlic until pink and smooth.
Spread on the tortillas and fill with the sweet potato, rocket and crumbled feta.
Roll tight and slice into spirals.

veg.make_ahead: Reheat in the oven, up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Press the dough into an oiled tray right to the edges.
Spread with crushed tomatoes mixed with oregano and top with mozzarella and the plant-based pepperoni.
Bake at 240C until bubbling and golden.
Cut into squares.
Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk in the chopped chocolate, cocoa, sugar and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into a warmed thermos to keep hot, then serve in mugs topped with marshmallows.
Toast the sourdough.
Mash the drained beans with the butter, chopped capers, lemon juice and chopped parsley. Season well.
Spread on the toast and top with thinly sliced radish and black pepper.
Roll the plant-based mince into 12 small balls.
Smash on a hot griddle and cook briefly, then melt a slice of cheese on each.
Mix the mayonnaise into a burger sauce and slice the pickles and onion.
Fill the buns and stack them high on a platter.
Chill the plates.
Peel the kohlrabi, slice paper thin on a mandoline and lay on the plates.
Dress with lime juice, finger lime pearls, a few drops of oil and sea salt.
Simmer the potatoes and onion in the vegetable stock until soft, then mash smooth.
Shred the kale finely and slice the vegetarian sausages.
Add both and simmer.
Drizzle with olive oil.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Cut rounds from the pastry, line a 24 hole mini muffin tin and blind-bake.
Dice the brie and drained capsicum and chop the chives.
Fill the cases. Whisk the eggs with the cream, pour in and bake at 170C.
Bake until just set.
Rub most of the butter into part of the flour with the baking powder and stir in the buttermilk.
Cut rounds and bake at 220C.
Brown the plant-based sausage mince in the rest of the butter, stir in the remaining flour and then the milk.
Simmer with lots of cracked peppercorns until thick.
Split the biscuits and pour over the gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Remoulade up to 2 days ahead, fry just before serving

steps.text: Slice the tomatoes thick, salt them and leave for 10 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise with chopped capers and lemon juice for the remoulade.
Mix the paprika into the cornmeal. Heat the oil and butter in a large pan until the butter foams.
Dip the tomatoes in buttermilk then the cornmeal and fry until golden, turning once.
Soften the sliced onion and garlic in half the oil with the chilli flakes and paprika.
Add the vegetable stock and simmer.
Strip the stems from the kale and chop. Add and braise gently.
Dice the smoked tofu, fry in the rest of the oil until crisp and stir through.
Finish with the soy and vinegar and serve in bowls with plenty of pot liquor.
Cut the cheese into shards. Warm the honey with chilli flakes and drizzle over.
Cut the drained capsicum into strips and wrap around wedges of rockmelon with mint leaves.
Chop the parsley with capers, lemon zest and oil for salsa verde.
Toast baguette slices, spread with salsa verde and top each with a sun-dried tomato.
Lay it all out in neat rows on a long board.
Cook the rice with the tomatoes and vegetable stock into a thick risotto.
Stir in the grated cheese and cool completely.
Roll around cubes of mozzarella.
Crumb in beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C until golden.
Rinse the rice and cook it.
Season with rice vinegar, caster sugar and salt and cool.
Cut the eggplant into thin slices the length of a finger, fry in the oil until soft, then glaze with a splash of the soy and the glaze sugar.
Shape the rice into fingers with a touch of wasabi under each.
Top with the eggplant or sliced avocado. Serve with pickled ginger and soy.
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry until golden.
Grill the vegetarian bratwurst until browned, then slice.
Soften the onion, add the tomato paste, curry powder, sugar, vinegar and water and simmer.
Pour over the sliced bratwurst and dust with curry powder. Serve with the chips.

veg.n: Particular set of skills mushroom croque
veg.make_ahead: Assemble ahead, bake just before serving

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in a little of the butter until golden and season.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and cook until thick.
Spread the bread with Dijon and bechamel.
Fill with the mushrooms and half the grated cheese, then close.
Top with the rest of the sauce and cheese.
Bake at 200C until bubbling.
Finely dice the shallots and mix with the vinegar and pepper.
Rest.
Tear the mushrooms into pieces and sear in the oil over high heat with a pinch of salt until golden. Cool, then chill.
Lay the mushrooms in small spoons on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette alongside.
